description.value: A 24/7 McDonald's fast-food location in Pitt Meadows offering the full Canadian menu including burgers, breakfast, and McCafé beverages. The restaurant features a drive-through, indoor seating, and air conditioning, making it a reliable all-weather rest stop for cyclists on long routes through the Pitt Meadows area. On-site washrooms and wheelchair accessibility add to its utility as a mid-ride stop.
